answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The mesa holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wander of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
